senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (गडति)
To distil or drop, to run as a liquid; also, गल.
(इ) गडि r. 1st cl. (गण्डति)
To affect the cheek, to be rough as the cheek, (obsolete.)

m. (-ड)
1 A kind of fish, the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM.
2 Another species, (Cyprinus garra. HAM.) see गल.
3 An impediment, an obstacle.
4 A screen, a covering, a fence.
5 A moat, a ditch.
6 A country, part of Malva, Gerha or Gera Mendela.
E.
गड to drop, affix अच्.

m. (-कः)
A kind of fish: see the last.
E.
गड to drop, affix क्वुन्

m. (-न्तः)
A cloud.
E.
गड to drop (water), Uṇādi affix झच् and अय substituted for the penultimate.

n. (-णं)
Rock or fossile salt, especially that found in the district of Sāmbher in the province of Ajmere.
E.
गड a country, and लवण salt.

m. (-डिः)
1 A steer.
2 A lazy ox.
E.
गड to drop, इन् aff.

mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु)
Crooked, humpbacked, &c.
m. (-डुः)
1 A hump on the back.
2 Goitre or Bronchocele.
3 A humpbacked man.
4 A javelin, a spear.
5 An earth-worm.
6 A water pot.
E.
गड to drop, Uṇādi affix उ.

n. (-कं)
1 A water pot.
2 A finger ring.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-कः)
A golden vase.
E.
गड to sprinkle, डुक Uṇādi affix; also गड्डूक and occasionally गडुक.

m. (-कः)
A golden water vessel: see the preceding.

mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं)
Having a goitre.
E.
गडु, and कण्ठ the throat.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Crooked, bent, humpbacked.
E.
गडु a hump, and र substituted for ल: see the next.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Crooked, humpbacked.
E.
गडु hump, and लच् affix; also गडुर.

m. (-रः)
A cloud.
E.
गड to drop (water), and एरक् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्थं)
Fossile salt.
E.
गड the country, and उत्थ produced.

m. (-लः)
1 A mouthful.
2 Raw sugar.
E.
गड to drop, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also गण्डोल.

f. (-का)
1 A sudden rush of water of which the source is unknown.
2 A single ewe preceding a flock of sheep.
